faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Mumbai Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Associate - Ecosystem & Community - Tejas post is 11 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in any discipline is required. A Master's degree in Management, Communication, Social Sciences, or an allied discipline is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are needed?
faq.answer: A minimum of 05 years of post-qualification professional experience in community engagement, ecosystem or partnership management, programme or event management, or student, alumni and corporate relations is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 800000 Per Annum.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Skill Test, and Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website of IIM Mumbai.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.
